intro: Extract G-code thumbnail pulls out the preview images the slicer stores inside the G-code or bgcode, the same ones shown by the printer screen, OctoPrint or PrusaLink. Download them as PNG to use in a catalogue, a product sheet, a job list or a post.

PNG, JPG and QOI thumbnails from PrusaSlicer, OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio, SuperSlicer and Cura (with its thumbnail plugin) are read, both in text G-code comments and in bgcode blocks. QOI images, used by Prusa printers, are converted to PNG. Each thumbnail comes with its size in the name, from largest to smallest.

If the file has none, the slicer does not have them enabled: in PrusaSlicer they are in Printer Settings, G-code, Thumbnails. For an image of the toolpaths instead of the preview, use G-code to image.
You can process up to ten files per task and download everything in a ZIP. They are processed on our server in the European Union and deleted automatically when they expire.

faq.a: Because the slicer stores several sizes: a small one for lists and a large one for the screen.

faq.q: Can I set a new thumbnail?
faq.a: Not with this tool: generate the G-code again with the thumbnails you want.
Use Extract G-code from 3MF, which pulls out each plate's G-code and image.

faq.q: What size do they come out?
faq.a: The size the slicer stored them at; it goes in each file's name.

faq.q: Does it work with Klipper or Mainsail files?
faq.a: Yes, if the slicer embedded the thumbnails in the G-code in the usual format.
